name: solomd-mcp
description: Read and search a folder of Markdown notes from an MCP client: notes, full-text search, backlinks, tags, tasks, outlines and version history.
long_description: The MCP server that ships with SoloMD, a free, open-source Markdown editor (solomd.app). It works on any plain folder of .md files, with or without the editor installed. Tools list and read notes, search them (literal or regex), follow wikilink backlinks, collect tags and checkbox tasks, return heading outlines, export a note to HTML, Markdown, text or Word, and read SoloMD's per-note AutoGit history and diffs. This bundle is read-only: writing, appending and rolling back need the server started with --allow-write, which you can add to the arguments yourself.

workspace.title: Notes folder
workspace.description: The folder of Markdown notes the server may read.

tools.name: append_to_note
tools.description: Append text to an existing note.

tools.name: autogit_diff
tools.description: Show a unified diff for one note between two AutoGit commits.

tools.name: autogit_log
tools.description: List the commit history for a single note from SoloMD's AutoGit repo (saves are auto-committed).

tools.name: autogit_rollback
tools.description: Restore a note's content from a specific AutoGit commit by overwriting the working tree.

tools.name: export_note
tools.description: Export a Markdown note to html / md / txt / docx.

tools.name: get_backlinks
tools.description: Return wikilink-style backlinks (`[[note_name]]`) to the given note.

tools.name: get_outline
tools.description: Return the heading outline of a note, with level (1-6), text, and 1-based line number.

tools.name: list_notes
tools.description: List Markdown notes in a SoloMD workspace.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List every tag found in a workspace (body `#tag` and front-matter `tags:`), sorted by count desc.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: Return every Markdown checkbox (`- [ ]` / `- [x]`) in the workspace, with its file, 1-based line number, done state, and text.

tools.name: read_agent_trace
tools.description: Return the agent run trace as an array of step objects.

tools.name: share_url
tools.description: Return the public solomd.app/share/ URL for a note.

tools.name: sync_status
tools.description: Return SoloMD's GitHub-sync configuration for a workspace: linked remote, current branch, encryption flag, last push/pull timestamps.

tools.name: write_note
tools.description: Write a Markdown note to disk.
